narration.text: Here's a quick look at Brother Point of Sale. A modern, fast system built for cannabis retail.
Clerks sign in with a quick four digit pin. Cloud stores can require email and password first for extra security.
The manager opens the cash drawer with a starting float, and the register is ready to sell.
This is the main register. Products on the left, cart on the right. Everything in one view.
You can look up customers instantly. Loyalty points, purchase history, and contact info all right here.
Products can be scanned with a barcode reader, or searched and tapped from the grid.
Weight based products show preset sizes. An eighth, a quarter, a half ounce. One tap to add.
Products with multiple options, like edibles or vape cartridges, let you choose the exact variation.
Discounts are built right in. Percentage off, dollar amount, or store-wide promotions.
Payment is flexible. Cash, debit, or split across multiple methods. All tracked automatically.
That's the register in action. Now let's take a quick look at the admin dashboard, where you manage everything behind the scenes.
